forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.description: Enter your account email to receive a password reset OTP.
forgot.successMessage: Please check your email to reset your password.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.description: Enter the OTP and a new password for your MoveVN account.
reset.successMessage: You can now sign in with your new password.

verify.title: Verify email
verify.description: Enter the 6-digit OTP MoveVN sent to your email.
verify.successMessage: You can now sign in to MoveVN.
